# Content Learnings (auto-generated 2026-03-15)

> Data source: 204 reels scraped across 7 accounts on 2026-03-15.
> These rules are loaded into the Claude system prompt by autopilot.py.

## @aliyah.journals (JournalLock) — 1,522 avg views/reel ⭐ TOP PERFORMER
- **Plant/guilt metaphor hooks are top tier** — "tiny plant shrinks when i don't write" averages 1,500+ views. This is the strongest hook format for this account.
- **Question hooks work best here** — "wait why does protecting my thoughts feel like i'm doing something wrong 😭" hit 2,069 views. Use more "wait why does..." openers.
- **Contrast numbers drive engagement** — "2,847 hours vs 3" (2,177 views). The gap between screen time and journaling time is the emotional core.
- **"200+ pickups" framing is the breakout number** — 2,229 views. More impactful than "7 hours" because pickups feel more visceral.
- AVOID: repeating "i did the math on my screen time" without a twist — the bottom 5 reels all use this exact opener and average 160 views.

## @aliyah.manifests (ManifestLock) — 1,078 avg views/reel
- **Social witness hooks outperform solo hooks** — "I didn't believe the math until I did it in front of her" (1,322 views) vs solo math hooks (~150 views).
- **Physical reaction hooks work** — "did the math and honestly? had to sit down" (1,163 views). The body response adds credibility.
- **Emoji + vulnerability combo** — "honestly didn't think anything could help me 😭" (1,388 views). Single emoji at an emotional peak, not scattered throughout.
- **Goal-setting angle is unique to this account** — ManifestLock content should emphasize goals/intentions, not just screen time reduction.
- AVOID: generic "i did the math on my screen time. [number] hours this year. gone." — 5 reels use this exact format, all under 130 views.

## Cross-Persona Patterns

### Hook Formula That Works Everywhere
**[Specific number] + [social context or unexpected metaphor] + [emotional reaction]**
- "200+ pickups" + "was my wake up call" + "lol" → 2,229 views
- "she thought i was joking" + "tried to check instagram mid-session" + silence → 3,057 views

### Rules for All Accounts
1. **NEVER use "i did the math on my screen time" as the opener** — 71 reels use this base, it's saturated. Always add a twist (contrast, social witness, physical reaction).
2. **Question hooks are underused and outperform** — only 8 reels use "wait why does..." but they average 1,316 views. Generate more of these.
3. **Combine two patterns** — single-pattern hooks average 600 views; dual-pattern hooks average 1,200+.
4. **Each reel caption must be unique across all accounts** — near-duplicate captions across accounts correlate with sub-200 views. No copy-pasting.
5. **Plant metaphor hooks are exclusive to Aliyah** — keep them there, they're working (avg 1,194 views). Don't dilute by using on other personas.
